title: Sweet Structures — Carbohydrates
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B carbohydrates in six modes: Classify Sugars, Fischer Projections, Haworth Rings, Stereochemistry, Di- & Polysaccharides, and Sugar Reactions. Covers aldoses and ketoses, D and L sugars, converting Fischer projections to Haworth rings, alpha and beta anomers, glycosidic linkages, and common sugar reactions. Includes hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, and achievement badges.
